easy.q: The North Pole sits at how many degrees of north latitude?
easy.fact: The equator is 0 degrees, the starting line for latitude.

easy.q: How many superheroes make up Marvel's Fantastic Four?
easy.fact: They debuted in a 1961 comic by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.

easy.q: How many lanes are used in an Olympic swimming final?
easy.fact: Olympic pools have 10 lanes, but the two outside ones stay empty.

easy.q: A fortnight is how many days?
easy.fact: The word comes from the Old English for "fourteen nights."

easy.q: A silver wedding anniversary marks how many years of marriage?

medium.q: In the video game Valorant, how many players are on each team in a standard match?
medium.fact: Riot Games released it in June 2020.

medium.q: The U.S. bought the Louisiana Territory from France in 1803 for how many million dollars?
medium.fact: The purchase roughly doubled the size of the country.

medium.q: To the nearest 10 miles, how wide is the Bering Strait at its narrowest point?
medium.fact: Russia's Big Diomede and Alaska's Little Diomede islands sit about 2.4 miles apart in the strait.

medium.q: How many universities make up the Ivy League?
medium.fact: It became a formal athletic conference in 1954.

medium.q: How many squares are on each player's grid in the board game Battleship?
medium.fact: Rows run A to J and columns 1 to 10.

hard.q: To the nearest foot, how high above the Arkansas River is Colorado's Royal Gorge Bridge deck?
hard.fact: It was the world's highest bridge from 1929 to 2001.

hard.q: To the nearest foot, how far is it from home plate to second base in MLB?
hard.fact: The bases themselves are 90 feet apart.

hard.q: In Jaws (1975), how many feet long is the great white shark said to be?
hard.fact: The crew nicknamed the mechanical shark "Bruce."

hard.q: To the nearest year, how long did England's Tudor dynasty rule, from Henry VII's victory in 1485 to 1603?
hard.fact: Elizabeth I, the last Tudor, never married and had no heirs.
